name: newtime_close_gui
verified_note: The closing click of newtime_quantize_save_gui on its own (confirmed by hand on FL 26.1.7 at 2560x1440, 2026-10-29): Newtime's X at (725, 15) of the WarpCorrection window, no question asked. Used by quantize_vocal_chunks_gui to leave a chunk that could not be fitted (markers not seen) so the next chunk can open Newtime from the clip menu again. quantize_vocal_chunks_gui presses Escape for a stuck dialog first and runs this only while the editor is open.
summary: Close an open Newtime window without saving.
